summary: Derived a complete handwritten proof of a coefficient-uniform pointwise upper bound H_alpha(N) <= omega_{>N^alpha}(N) + C*S(N)*N/log(N)^2*(epsilon+1/log(N))^2 for every sufficiently large even N, simultaneously for alpha=1/3-epsilon in [0.3,1/3]. The exceptional term counts prime divisors of N above N^alpha and is at most 3. The proof uses inspected Ford Theorem 2.5 and an explicit partial-summation consequence of Mertens, and treats repeated factors and gcd(ab,N)>1 separately. It is a classical sieve consequence pending the separate critic, with no formal verification or novelty claim. A pure epsilon-squared bound without remainder is refuted when epsilon varies with N by N=r^3+3. The required pointwise parity-sensitive lower bound remains open and Goldbach is not solved. A separately authored supplemental endpoint lemma is attached as an artifact for the critic; this statement author has not independently reviewed its proof.

claims.text: The pointwise contamination bound (H) follows from the inspected classical coefficient-uniform two-linear-form upper sieve and Mertens estimate, with an exceptional term at most 3 and absolute unspecified effective constants and all stated boundary cases.
A pure C*epsilon^2*S(N)*N/log(N)^2 upper bound for H without remainder cannot hold uniformly when epsilon depends on N.
The pointwise lower bound (P-open), sufficient in conjunction with (H) for sufficiently-large Goldbach, is not proved in this stage.
